algorithm.arrays_ts: TS admitted arrays require exact Array.prototype (reject Proxy), own keys only length + dense indices 0..length-1; length descriptor must be data value uint32 with writable=true, enumerable=false, configurable=false before any property read; each index enumerable/writable/configurable data property; reject symbols, extra strings, accessors, sparse, subclass/custom proto, frozen arrays (length writable=false), and never read value.length
algorithm.effect_command_request_digest: public serialized EffectCommandV1 shape excludes request_digest; any present field (null/valid/malformed/mismatch) is rejected at Python/TS/schema/helper boundaries; derived only on Python dataclass result. Official serializer is effect_command_to_dict / effect_command_body_v1 only; dataclasses.asdict is unsupported because nested MappingProxyType freezes raise TypeError
algorithm.fixture_materialization: Lone UTF-16 surrogate fixtures are encoded as $materialize_utf16_units / $materialize_utf16_key_entry / $materialize_merge_utf16_key recipes so the shared JSON is valid UTF-8 for jq and generic loaders. Harnesses materialize recipes in-memory only; recipe markers never enter the admitted JSON domain.
algorithm.name: admitted_domain_canonical_json_v1
algorithm.numbers: js_safe_integers_only; 1.0 serializes as 1; -0.0 serializes as 0; non-integers rejected
algorithm.proxy_rejection: TS Node-targeted normalizeAdmittedJsonV1 rejects node:util types.isProxy immediately after typeof===object, before instanceof/Array meta-ops/descriptors/Zod.
algorithm.timestamps: normalized_utc_or_offset_with_seconds; admitted calendar year 0001-9999; schema pattern excludes year 0000 when expressible; public parsers enforce calendar validity and year bounds
algorithm.unicode_scalars: admitted strings/object keys must be Unicode scalar values; unpaired UTF-16 surrogates rejected in public wrappers, Zod AdmittedJsonValueV1Schema/contract schemas, and generated JSON Schema string/propertyNames patterns (pair-aware; valid pairs/U+10000/emoji accepted) before canonicalization/parse/digest/ID
